employer.employee.compensation.component:
As an employee of {0}, you receive regular pay for the services you provide. The other part of your total compensation is the value of the benefits that {0} makes available to you and your family. This personalized total compensation statement is intended to give you a summary of the available benefits and their value. As you review this statement, you will see the value of your benefits added to your annual pay produce your total compensation. The statement is designed to show how much your service is valued by {0}.
If you find any inaccuracies or have questions concerning your benefits and this statement, please contact Human Resources.

This personalized benefits statement is not a legal document. All benefits are governed by the actual benefit plans, and in the event of any inconsistencies the official plan documents will govern. Some benefits have been calculated based on averages. {0} reserves the right to change, suspend, or cancel its benefit policies or practices with or without notice.
